answer: Here is one concrete wall: Honoured research chemist licence with chemical society attestation. It works because a licence the society renews after laboratory audits, and the echo it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the oasis is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Time is the tax here: a licence the society renews after laboratory audits cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the ripple for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
